decisions.reason: Displaying help text on both the label and field does not change the requirement that each field's user-entered content remain independent.
The source specifies where help text appears but does not change the existing behavior for clearing placeholder content when a field is activated.
Help-text placement does not necessarily alter the selected editable-text representation or its robustness requirement.
The source does not change the requirement that the Title field preserve its formatting when content is entered or replaced.
Adding help text at the label and field locations does not resolve or modify the separate requirement for a visible editable-field cue or its unresolved grey appearance.
The source does not enable, disable, or otherwise change the Board Meeting dropdown control.
Help-text placement does not change the calendar-dropdown selection method required for date fields.
The source does not change the checklist control's type or enabled state.
The source changes help-text locations only and does not change the required Danish language, translations, or placeholder text.
The textual overlap is incidental; help-text placement has no effect on bullet sizing, alignment, balance, reference design, or color.
The help-text location decision does not alter the requirement to include the customer theme colors.
The source concerns interactive-field help placement and does not change the prescribed style catalog or its deployment across templates.
